model_selection.hard_FPR_budget_policy: FPR is reported; no production alert budget was imposed

aggregation.grouped_CV: pooled outer out-of-fold predictions plus every fold and support
aggregation.common_LLM_comparison: exact same selected observation IDs/order for every method
aggregation.cross_cohort_single_weighted_score: not used for selecting the winner

class_reference.legacy: original five-class labels retained as historical reference

sample_weights.primary: one weight per unique stored observation

missing_decisions.primary_ranking: requires complete decisions on the planned evaluation IDs
missing_decisions.incomplete_runs: show coverage/status counts and conditional successful-decision metrics; primary F1 remains null

input_modes.SQL+context: same observation IDs and predecision whitelisted context; source/targets/groups/evidence/outcomes excluded

LLM.main_selection: prefixes of frozen within-stratum ordering, independent of predictions
LLM.prompt_tuning: development only; final common test fixed separately

prerequisites: freeze acquisition/lineage/unit/license/context criteria before source search
pin source bytes and evaluation IDs before predictions
final_new_source.known_sources: SQLStateGuard and the current controlled corpus are known evaluation data
